{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Cross-tabulate channel with customer_segment and customer_age to check comparability

# Check distribution of customer_segment across channels
customer_segment_cross = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print('Customer segment distribution by channel:\n', customer_segment_cross)

# Check mean customer_age by channel
age_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].mean()
print('\nMean customer age by channel:\n', age_by_channel)

# Check conversion rates by customer_segment and channel to see if segment affects outcome
conversion_by_segment_channel = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('\nConversion rates by channel and customer_segment:\n', conversion_by_segment_channel)"}
